00047 template<class ObjectType>
00048 class ObjectArrayInternal : public SmartPointer
00049 {
00050 public: 
00051  ObjectArrayInternal(const int size, const bool isNullTerminated)
00052  : size_(size <= 0 ? 0 : size), 
00053   array(size_ == 0 ? 0 : new ObjectType[size_]),
00054   arrayIsNullTerminated(isNullTerminated),
00055   ownsTheData(true)
00056  {
00057  }
00058  
00059  ObjectArrayInternal(const int size, ObjectType *dataToUse, const bool isNullTerminated)
00060  : size_(size <= 0 ? 0 : size), 
00061   array(size_ == 0 ? 0 : dataToUse),
00062   arrayIsNullTerminated(isNullTerminated),
00063   ownsTheData(size_ == 0 ? true : false)
00064  {
00065  }
00066  
00067  ~ObjectArrayInternal()
00068  {
00069   if(ownsTheData) 
00070    delete [] array;
00071  }
00072  
00073  inline int size() const throw() { return size_; }
00074  inline int length() const throw() 
00075  { 
00076   if(size_ == 0) 
00077    return 0;
00078   else
00079    return arrayIsNullTerminated ? size_ - 1 : size_; 
00080  }
00081  
00082  inline ObjectType* getArray() throw() { return array; }
00083  inline const ObjectType* getArray() const throw() { return array; }
00084  inline bool isNullTerminated() const throw() { return arrayIsNullTerminated; }
00085  inline void setNullTerminated(const bool state) throw() { arrayIsNullTerminated = state; } 
00086  
00087  inline void add(ObjectType const& item) throw()
00088  {
00089   const int newSize = size_ + 1;
00090   ObjectType *newArray = new ObjectType[newSize];
00091   
00092   if(arrayIsNullTerminated)
00093   {
00094    const int length = size_ - 1;
00095    
00096    newArray[size_] = array[length];
00097    newArray[length] = item;
00098    
00099    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00100    {
00101     newArray[i] = array[i];
00102    }
00103   }
00104   else
00105   {
00106    const int length = size_;
00107    newArray[size_] = item;
00108    
00109    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00110    {
00111     newArray[i] = array[i];
00112    }
00113   }
00114   
00115   if(ownsTheData)
00116    delete [] array;
00117   
00118   size_ = newSize;
00119   array = newArray;
00120  }
00121   
00122  inline void remove(const int index) throw()
00123  {  
00124   if(index < 0 || index >= size_) return;
00125   
00126   if(size_ == 1)
00127   {
00128    if(ownsTheData)
00129    {
00130     delete [] array;
00131     array = 0;
00132    }
00133    
00134    size_ = 0;
00135   }
00136   else
00137   {
00138    const int newSize = size_ - 1;
00139    ObjectType *newArray = new ObjectType[newSize];
00140    
00141    for(int i = 0; i < index; i++)
00142    {
00143     newArray[i] = array[i];
00144    }
00145    
00146    for(int i = index; i < newSize; i++)
00147    {
00148     newArray[i] = array[i+1];
00149    }
00150    
00151    if(ownsTheData)
00152     delete [] array;
00153    
00154    size_ = newSize;
00155    array = newArray;
00156   }
00157  }
00158  
00159 private:
00160  int size_;
00161  ObjectType *array;
00162  bool arrayIsNullTerminated : 1;
00163  bool ownsTheData : 1;
00164 
00165  
00166  ObjectArrayInternal();
00167  ObjectArrayInternal (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00168  const ObjectArrayInternal& operator= (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00169 };

00298  template<class CollectionType>
00299  static ObjectArray<ObjectType> collect(ObjectArray<CollectionType> const& collection) throw()
00300  {
00301   const int length = collection.length();
00302   
00303   ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(length, false);
00304   
00305   for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00306   {
00307    result.put(i, ObjectType(collection[i]));
00308   }
00309   
00310   return result;
00311  }

00313  template<class CollectionType1, class CollectionType2>
00314  static ObjectArray<ObjectType> collect(ObjectArray<CollectionType1> const& collection1,
00315              ObjectArray<CollectionType2> const& collection2) throw()
00316  {
00317   const int length = ugen::max(collection1.length(), collection2.length());
00318   
00319   ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(length, false);
00320   
00321   for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00322   {
00323    result.put(i, ObjectType(collection1.wrapAt(i), 
00324           collection2.wrapAt(i)));
00325   }
00326   
00327   return result;
00328  }

00648  ObjectArray(ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& array0, 
00649     ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& array1) throw()
00650  : SmartPointerContainer< ObjectArrayInternal<ObjectType> >
00651   (new ObjectArrayInternal<ObjectType>(0, false))
00652  {
00653   const bool bothNullTerminated = array0.isNullTerminated() && array1.isNullTerminated();
00654   const bool eitherNullTerminated = array0.isNullTerminated() || array1.isNullTerminated();
00655   const int summedSizes = array0.size() + array1.size();
00656   const int newSize = bothNullTerminated ? summedSizes - 1 : summedSizes;
00657   
00658   if(newSize > 0)
00659   {
00660    this->setInternal(new ObjectArrayInternal<ObjectType>(newSize, eitherNullTerminated));
00661    
00662    int newIndex = 0;
00663    
00664    ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
00665    
00666    if(array != 0)
00667    {
00668     const ObjectType *arrayPtr0 = array0.getArray();
00669     const ObjectType *arrayPtr1 = array1.getArray();
00670     
00671     for(int i = 0; i < array0.length(); i++) {
00672      array[newIndex++] = arrayPtr0[i];
00673     }
00674         
00675     for(int i = 0; i < array1.length(); i++) {
00676      array[newIndex++] = arrayPtr1[i];
00677     }
00678     
00679     if(eitherNullTerminated)
00680      array[newIndex] = getNull();
00681    }
00682   }
00683  }

00985  template<class WeightType>
00986  ObjectType& wchoose (ObjectArray<WeightType> const& weights) throw()
00987  {
00988   if(this->getInternal()->size() == 0) 
00989   {
00990    return getNull();
00991   }
00992   else 
00993   {
00994    const int length = this->length();
00995    ObjectArray<WeightType> thresholds = ObjectArray<WeightType>(length, false);
00996    
00997    WeightType sum = 0;
00998    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00999    {
01000     sum += weights.wrapAt(i);
01001     thresholds[i] = sum;
01002    }
01003    
01004    WeightType random = rand(sum);
01005    
01006    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
01007    {
01008     if(random < thresholds[i])
01009      return this->getArray()[i];
01010    }
01011    
01012    return this->getArray()[length-1];
01013   }
01014  }

01134  bool contains (ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& itemsToSearchFor) const throw()
01135  {
01136   const ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
01137   const ObjectType *items = itemsToSearchFor.getArray();
01138   
01139   if(array != 0 && items != 0)
01140   {
01141    const int length = this->length();
01142    int itemsToFind = itemsToSearchFor.length();
01143    
01144    if(length == 0 || itemsToFind == 0)
01145     return false;
01146    
01147    int nextIndexToFind = 0;
01148    
01149    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
01150    {
01151     if(array[i] == items[nextIndexToFind])
01152     {
01153      itemsToFind--;
01154      
01155      while(itemsToFind > 0)
01156      {
01157       i++;
01158       nextIndexToFind++;
01159       
01160       if((i > length) || (array[i] != items[nextIndexToFind]))
01161        return false;
01162       
01163       itemsToFind--;
01164      }
01165      
01166      return true;
01167     }
01168    }
01169   }  
01170   
01171   return false;
01172  }

01284  ObjectArray<ObjectType> range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
01285  {
01286   const int size = this->size();
01287   if(size == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
01288   
01289   const int startIndexChecked = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex;
01290   const int endIndexChecked = endIndex > size ? size : endIndex;
01291 
01292   if(startIndexChecked >= endIndexChecked) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
01293   
01294   const ObjectType *sourceArray = this->getArray();
01295   if(sourceArray == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
01296   
01297   const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
01298   
01299   const int diff = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
01300   const int newSize = needsNull && (endIndexChecked < size) ? diff + 1 : diff;
01301     
01302   ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(newSize, needsNull);
01303   ObjectType *resultArray = result.getArray();
01304   
01305   int resultIndex = 0;
01306   for(int sourceIndex = startIndexChecked; sourceIndex < endIndexChecked; sourceIndex++)
01307   {
01308    resultArray[resultIndex++] = sourceArray[sourceIndex];
01309   }  
01310   
01311   if(needsNull)
01312    resultArray[resultIndex] = this->getNull();
01313   
01314   return result;
01315  }

01319  ObjectArray<ObjectType> replace(ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& find, ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& substitute) const throw()
01320  {
01321   const int size = this->size();
01322   const int findLength = find.length();
01323   int startIndex = 0;
01324   int findIndex;
01325   
01326   ObjectArray<ObjectType> result;
01327   
01328   while((findIndex = this->indexOf(find, startIndex)) >= 0)
01329   {
01330    result.add(this->range(startIndex, findIndex));
01331    result.add(substitute);
01332    startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
01333   }
01334   
01335   result.add(this->range(startIndex, size));
01336   
01337   return result;
01338  }

01365  ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > group(const int groupSize) const throw()
01366  {
01367   const int length = this->length();
01368   if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
01369   
01370   const int groupSizeChecked = groupSize < 1 ? 1 : groupSize;
01371   const int groupSizeMinus1 = groupSizeChecked-1;
01372   const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
01373   
01374   ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
01375   ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
01376   
01377   const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
01378   
01379   for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
01380   {
01381    element <<= thisArray[i];
01382    if((i % groupSizeChecked) == groupSizeMinus1)
01383    {
01384     if(needsNull) 
01385     {
01386      element.add(this->getNull());
01387      element.setNullTerminated(true);
01388     }
01389     
01390     result.add(element);
01391     element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>(); // reset
01392    }
01393   }
01394   
01395   if(element.length() != 0)
01396   {
01397    if(needsNull) 
01398    {
01399     element.add(this->getNull());
01400     element.setNullTerminated(true);
01401    }
01402    
01403    result.add(element);
01404   }
01405   
01406   return result;
01407  }

01411  ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > split(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimiters) const throw()
01412  {
01413   const int length = this->length();
01414   if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
01415   
01416   const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
01417   
01418   ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
01419   ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
01420   
01421   const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
01422   if(thisArray != 0)
01423   {
01424    for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
01425    {
01426     const ObjectType item = thisArray[i];
01427     
01428     if(delimiters.contains(item))
01429     {
01430      if(element.length() > 0)
01431      {
01432       if(needsNull) 
01433       {
01434        element.add(this->getNull());
01435        element.setNullTerminated(true);
01436       }
01437       
01438       result.add(element);
01439       element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>(); // reset
01440      }
01441     }
01442     else
01443     {
01444      element.add(item);
01445     }
01446    }
01447    
01448    if(element.length() != 0)
01449    {
01450     if(needsNull) 
01451     {
01452      element.add(this->getNull());
01453      element.setNullTerminated(true);
01454     }
01455     
01456     result.add(element);
01457    }
01458   }
01459   
01460   return result;  
01461  }
01462  
01463  ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > splitSequence(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimitingSequence) const throw()
01464  {
01465   const int size = this->size();
01466   ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
01467   
01468   if(size != 0)
01469   {
01470    const int findLength = delimitingSequence.length();
01471    int startIndex = 0;
01472    int findIndex;
01473    
01474    while((findIndex = this->indexOf(delimitingSequence, startIndex)) >= 0)
01475    {
01476     result.add(this->range(startIndex, findIndex));
01477     startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
01478    }
01479    
01480    result.add(this->range(startIndex, size));
01481   }
01482   
01483   return result;  
01484  }

01505    const unsigned int newSize = leftSize > rightSize ? leftSize : rightSize;      \

01507    const NumericalType *rightArray = rightOperand.getArray()
01508 
01509 
01510 #define NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBody(OPERATOR)               \
01511    NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;               \
01512    NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
01513    NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();             \
01514    if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;           \
01515                            \
01516    for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {             \
01517     resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];   \
01518    }                        \
01519    return result
01520 
01521 #define NumericalArrayBinaryComparisonOperatorBody(OPERATOR)            \
01522    NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;               \
01523    NumericalArray<bool> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), false);       \
01524    bool *resultArray = result.getArray();               \
01525                            \
01526    for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {             \
01527     resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];   \
01528    }                        \
01529    return result
01530 
01531 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)               \
01532    NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;               \
01533    NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
01534    NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();             \
01535    if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;           \
01536                            \
01537    for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {             \
01538     resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)(leftArray[i % leftLength]),        \
01539             (double)(rightArray[i % rightLength]));       \
01540    }                        \
01541    return result
01542 
01543 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)                 \
01544    NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION (NumericalArray<NumericalType> const& rightOperand) const throw()  \
01545    {                            \
01546     NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);               \
01547    }
01548 
01549 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)               \
01550    const int newSize = this->size();                \
01551    const int newLength = this->length();               \
01552    if(newSize == 0) return *this;                 \
01553    const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();            \
01554    NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), needsNull);   \
01555    const NumericalType *thisArray = this->getArray();          \
01556    NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();             \
01557                            \
01558    for(int i = 0; i < newSize; i++)                \
01559     resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)thisArray[i]);           \
01560                            \
01561    if(needsNull) resultArray[newLength] = 0;              \
01562    return result
01563 
01564 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)              \
01565    NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION () const throw()           \
01566    {                        \
01567     NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);           \
01568    }

01709  static NumericalArray<NumericalType> line(const int size, const NumericalType start, const NumericalType end) throw()
01710  {
01711   ugen_assert(size >= 2);
01712   
01713   const int numValues = size < 2 ? 2 : size;
01714   
01715   NumericalArray<NumericalType> newArray = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::withSize(numValues);
01716   
01717   double inc = double(end - start) / (numValues - 1);
01718   double currentValue = start;
01719   NumericalType *outputValues = newArray.getArray();
01720   
01721   for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01722   {
01723    roundCopy(currentValue, outputValues[i]);
01724    currentValue += inc;
01725   }
01726   
01727   return newArray;
01728  }

01776  static NumericalArray<NumericalType> rand(const int size, 
01777              const NumericalType lower, 
01778              const NumericalType upper) throw()
01779  {
01780   ugen_assert(size > 0);
01781   
01782   const int numValues = size < 1 ? 1 : size;
01783   
01784   NumericalArray<NumericalType> newArray = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::withSize(numValues);
01785   NumericalType *outputValues = newArray.getArray();
01786   NumericalType diff = upper-lower;
01787   NumericalType randFactor = (NumericalType)1 / (NumericalType)RAND_MAX;
01788   
01789   for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01790   {
01791    NumericalType randomValue = rand() * randFactor;
01792    outputValues[i] = randomValue * diff + lower;
01793   }
01794   
01795   return newArray;
01796  }

01893  static NumericalArray<NumericalType> blackmanWindow(const int size, 
01894               const float alpha = 0.16f, 
01895               const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01896  {
01897   float a0 = (1.f-alpha) * 0.5f;
01898   float a1 = 0.5f;
01899   float a2 = alpha * 0.5f;
01900   
01901   return (-NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size) * a1 + NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size, 2.f) * a2 + a0) * peak;

02439

02441    {
02442     std::cout << this->at(i) << " ";
02443    }
02444

02446   }
02447   else
02448   {
02449    for(int i = 0; i < this->size(); i++)
02450    {
02451     if(prefix) std::cout << prefix;
02452     
02453     std::cout << "[" << i << "] = " << this->at(i) << std::endl;
02454    }
02455   }
02456  }

02751  {
02752   const int numRows = this->length();
02753   for(int i = row < 0 ? 0 : row; i < numRows; i++)
02754   {
02755    int c = this->atUnchecked(i).ObjectArray<ArrayType>::indexOf(item, column);
02756    if(c >= 0)
02757    {
02758     row = i;
02759     column = c;
02760     return;

02762   }
02763   
02764   row = -1;
02765   column = -1;

02767  
02768  bool isMatrix() const throw()
02769  {
02770   const int numRows = this->length();
02771   if(numRows < 2) return false;
02772   
02773   int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02774   if(numColumns < 2) return false;
02775   
02776   int prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02777   for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02778   {
02779    numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02780    if(numColumns != prevNumColumns)
02781     return false;
02782    
02783    prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02784   }
02785   
02786   return true;
02787  }

02792  }

02795  {
02796   const int numRows = this->length();
02797   if(numRows < 1) return 0;
02798   
02799   int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02800   
02801   int maxNumColumns = numColumns;
02802   for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02803   {
02804    numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02805    if(numColumns > maxNumColumns)
02806     maxNumColumns = numColumns;
02807   }
02808   
02809   return maxNumColumns;
02810  }

02816   for(int i = 0; i < numRows; i++)
02817   {
02818    const RowType& item = this->atUnchecked(i);
02819    result <<= item;
02820   }   
02821   
02822   return result;
